games.summary: Miffy survives repeated burn attempts and wins with Poitier.

beats.text: Inaki opens with three Fractals and follows with Zhang Jiao.
Remnant of Will supplies recovery and haunt counters after Alice reaches Umbra.
Safeguard Amulet stops one Burst Asunder; Slip Away later protects Miffy from another.
Two Remnant of Will activations grow Poitier into the finishing attacker.

games.summary: Inaki reaches ten Fractals and Miffy concedes to Burst Asunder.

beats.text: Inaki opens with four Fractals.
Regal Inquisition takes two cards, but leaves Shimmering Refraction in Inaki’s hand.
Remnant of Will provides recovery and the end-step mill finds Poitier.
Bifurcating Fractal brings Inaki to ten Fractals; the Burst Asunder threat forces the concession.

games.summary: Inaki stops Miffy’s recovery and wins with Burst Asunder plus Shimmering Refraction.

beats.text: Maledictum Vitae lets Miffy establish Alice’s Umbra access safely.
Undying Dreams boosts Poitier enough to remove Fluffy Shopkeep.
Glimmering Refusal denies the Remnant of Will Miffy needed after drawing with Devouring Malice.
Inaki negates both Fleeting Guards, then adds Shimmering Refraction as Miffy uses lineage releases.
